Learn how to transform any text snippet, article, or note into a highly engaging carousel for Instagram and LinkedIn using an AI carousel maker.

Updated: June 2026

How to convert text to a carousel?

  • Paste your text into an AI carousel generator like GoToFlow.
  • Choose a visual style (e.g., minimalist, corporate).
  • Review the AI-generated slides and edit text if needed.
  • Export to PDF (for LinkedIn) or images (for Instagram).

Why Convert Text to a Carousel?

Turning plain text into a visual carousel increases engagement on platforms like Instagram and LinkedIn. Users are more likely to swipe through visually appealing slides than read a wall of text.

Using a text to carousel AI generator like GoToFlow, you can instantly turn your thoughts into content.

Step-by-Step Workflow

1Prepare your text: Grab a paragraph, a list of tips, or a short essay.
2Use an AI Generator: Go to the AI Carousel Maker and select the "Text / Topic" input.
3Generate: The AI will automatically split your text into logical slides, create a hook, and apply a professional design.
4Publish: Download the result and post it.

Best Practices Checklist

Keep input text focused on one core idea.
Let the AI handle the slide splitting.
Review the final CTA slide to ensure it drives your desired action.

By automating this, you save hours of manual design work while maintaining a high-quality aesthetic.
